source_snapshot.script: Manual Validation; 60 attended and 60 machine minutes; code shared by three rows.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes a BMC DC power cycle and uptime/AER tail, omitting physical removal/insertion and explicit drive enumeration.

source_snapshot.historical_v3_1: Pending/Source Conflict because the Master requires hot swap while DeepSeek substitutes unrelated shared-code DC reboot semantics.

old_problem: The code is shared with unrelated System reboot variants, and DeepSeek contaminated this exact SD.1 identity with a DC-cycle command that performs no live drive removal/insertion and proves neither the correct drive nor storage-stack health. Target bay/serial/path, service procedure, data protection and recovery are project bindings, but the required operation and enumeration outcome are already clear in the Master.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. ED-02/ED-19 bind the exact row/variant and prohibit inheriting SY.4/SY.5 semantics. ED-09 makes E1.S removal/insertion a qualified human action, while the agent may safely collect read-only identity, disappearance/re-enumeration and health evidence after confirmation. Exact bay/serial, supported-service procedure and thresholds are fail-closed Project Configuration. Any DC cycle is separate recovery authorization, never test coverage.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1920, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/conflict analysis and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1923 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00005-V005 / dde877b0ced7038b.
Master explicitly requires physical E1.S hot swap and post-hot-swap enumeration; the DeepSeek BMC power cycle is a non-authoritative mismatched command and is removed.
ED-02/ED-19 preserve Source Key and Variant ID for this shared code so no System reboot row can substitute for SD.1 coverage.
ED-09 assigns removal/insertion, latch/LED confirmation and ESD handling to a qualified operator; automation is limited to read-only correlation and evidence.
OS device names are not identity. The plan binds bay and physical serial/PN/FW to backplane/controller/BDF/NVMe identifiers before and after, protecting boot/mount/RAID/LVM/data state.
No drive access, unmount, storage write, physical hot swap, BMC power command, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: E1.S live hot-swap with exact bay/serial re-enumeration and storage-health proof
test_case.purpose: Have a qualified operator live-remove and reinsert the exact approved E1.S drive while read-only automation proves intended disappearance and re-enumeration of the same physical device with healthy PCIe/NVMe/storage-stack and data state.
required_package: Exact Source Key/Variant ID and E1.S drive serial/PN/FW, bay, backplane, controller/BDF and OS/NVMe identity map
Platform/vendor confirmation that this bay/configuration supports live hot swap plus removal/insertion/dwell/latch/LED/ESD procedure
Expected disappearance/reappearance timeout, identity, NVMe SMART/health, PCIe AER/DPC, RAID/volume/filesystem and event limits
Qualified operator, read-only evidence tools, independent console/BMC/storage recovery and explicit decision on any DC-cycle recovery
test_case.test_command: REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; after exact identity mapping, supported-live-service proof, workload drain/data protection and recovery approval, collect complete read-only block/NVMe/PCIe/mount/RAID/LVM/multipath/filesystem/BMC/kernel baselines. A qualified operator records the correct bay/serial removal, dwell, insertion, latch and LED sequence. Correlate timestamps with expected device disappearance and return, then collect complete identity/health and stack evidence until stable. Do not use /dev naming alone, write storage, rebuild RAID, power-cycle, reset or retry. A separately approved DC cycle may be invoked only as recovery after preserving failed evidence and never counts as hot-swap execution.
test_case.expected_result: The exact target drive disappears within the approved interval after removal and the same serial/PN/FW reappears through the expected bay/backplane/controller/BDF/NVMe path after insertion. PCIe link, NVMe health, namespaces, RAID/volume/filesystem/multipath state and BMC/kernel events meet approved limits, no wrong/extra device changes, no data-integrity error occurs and the workload remains stopped until owner restoration approval.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct physical evidence of the approved live removal/insertion and exact serial/bay/path re-enumeration plus every storage, PCIe, event and data-integrity criterion. A DC reboot, uptime or AER tail cannot PASS. FAIL on wrong bay/drive, unsupported action, missing/late/wrong identity, AER/DPC/reset storm, degraded RAID/volume/filesystem, media/data error, health/evidence gap or recovery issue. BLOCKED at runtime when service support, identity/data-protection/recovery inputs are absent; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Never remove boot, mounted, swap, active-write, RAID/LVM/device-mapper or multipath storage without its explicit owner-approved handling and protection.
Bind physical bay/serial to controller/BDF/NVMe identity; stop on wrong label, latch resistance, damage or unexpected device change.
Physical handling is human-only with ESD/service controls; preserve all storage/kernel/BMC evidence without clearing logs.
Do not power-cycle, reset, rebuild or automatically retry; any recovery action is separate and owner-authorized.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and all shared-code identities plus approved bay/serial/backplane/controller/BDF/NVMe map
Supported hot-swap procedure, workload/data-protection/RAID/mount approval and independent recovery
Timestamped physical removal/dwell/insertion/latch/LED evidence and synchronized disappearance/reappearance timeline
Complete pre/post NVMe identity/SMART, PCIe AER/DPC, kernel/BMC, namespaces, RAID/LVM/multipath/filesystem and data-health evidence
DC-cycle disposition, no-wrong-drive/no-auto-retry audit, workload-restore authorization and engineer/end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, missing re-enumeration, AER/DPC/reset storm, degraded storage, data error, physical damage or management/thermal anomaly, stop, keep workloads quiesced, preserve evidence and do not retry. Use independent console/BMC/storage recovery; any reseat, controller reset, RAID action, reboot or DC cycle requires a separate approved step and cannot retroactively satisfy hot-swap coverage.

source_conflict.reason: The Master hot-swap procedure/criterion is authoritative; the unrelated DeepSeek DC-cycle/shared-System command is rejected rather than treated as competing required behavior.

blocked.reason: The hybrid method and PASS boundary are clear; exact target, service support, thresholds and recovery are fail-closed runtime configuration.

external_authorities.application: Preserves exact shared-code variant, assigns physical action to humans, separates power-cycle semantics and retains independent coverage.
